---
number: 103
title: M2.5 Part 4: One search framework
milestone: M2.5
labels:
  - Epic
---

Each search has its own loop, budget and result: stagnation is detected in four places, "run until solved or out of budget" in five, shrinking is written twice, `ProgramSearch` re-implements lexicase, ranking, restarts and confirmation, and evaluations are counted by four counters while bounded checks, robustness and program search are not counted at all; SMT, rewrite and enumerative searches are planned, and the budget comparisons in RESEARCH.md depend on equal counting.
We want one budget every evaluation is charged to, one search interface with a typed outcome that every search implements, shared search parts (stall detection, immigration, confirmation), and task scoring helpers shared across tasks.

Its responsibilities are:
* The budget and the outcome type
* The search interface, with every existing search behind it and the shared parts taken out of each
* Task scoring: shared helpers, a slimmer `ITask`, and no downcasts to concrete tasks

Evaluation counts in the golden runs should not change unless a run was undercounted, and any change should be listed with its cause, because RESEARCH.md compares searches on evaluations.

Order: budget and outcome; search interface; tasks.

Done when: every search runs through one interface against one budget, a new search needs no change outside its own files and one registration, and the golden runs pass with any count change explained.

Read first: README "Algorithms", "Benchmarking and choosing an algorithm", RESEARCH.md "Spec to verified circuit"
